description: This file defines the 'Node' class within the Twig templating engine. The class represents a node in the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) used for parsing and compiling Twig templates. It manages child nodes, attributes, and metadata related to template parsing.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the Twig AST, capable of managing child nodes, attributes, and template source context. It supports iteration, counting, and is designed for template parsing and compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Node instance with child nodes, attributes, line number, and optionally a tag. Validates child nodes are instances of Node.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node and its attributes, for debugging purposes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Passes each child node to the provided Compiler object for compilation.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number associated with this node in the template.

methods.name: getNodeTag
methods.description: Returns the tag associated with this node, if any.

methods.name: setNodeTag
methods.description: Sets the tag for this node; deprecated in favor of automatic tag assignment.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute exists for this node.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute; triggers deprecation warnings if applicable.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the value of an attribute; triggers deprecation warnings if applicable.

methods.name: deprecateAttribute
methods.description: Marks an attribute's usage as deprecated, associating a deprecation policy.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the node.

methods.name: hasNode
methods.description: Checks if a child node with a given name exists.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by name, with deprecation warning support.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets a child node by name, with deprecation warning support.

methods.name: removeNode
methods.description: Removes a child node by name.

methods.name: deprecateNode
methods.description: Marks a child node as deprecated.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the child nodes.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template source if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Associates a Source object with this node and its children.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the Source object associated with this node.
